name: Alpenhof Hubertus
beschreibung: The Alpenhof Hubertus is located in Hochpillberg, a district of the municipality of Pill in the Tyrolean lowlands. The hotel enjoys a tranquil hillside location at an altitude of approximately 1,000 metres, offering commanding views of the Inn Valley. The rooms are furnished with local wood and feature balconies. Amenities include a cosy wellness area with a sauna and steam bath, alongside a restaurant serving regional dishes. A distinctive highlight is the direct access to hiking paths and cross-country ski trails right from the doorstep. Guests can expect comfortable lodging that serves as an ideal base for exploring the surrounding peaks. In winter, the Hochfügen ski area can be reached by car in about 15 minutes.
